commit_message:
fftools/ffmpeg_dec: export subtitle_header in Decoder

This way the encoder does not need to access the decoder AVCodecContext,
which will allow to make it private in future commits.

fix_commit.message: fftools/ffmpeg_dec: deep-copy subtitle_header to fix use-after-free
fix_commit.author: Zhen Yan

findings.title: Decoder.subtitle_header stores a borrowed pointer into the AVCodecContext, leading to use-after-free
findings.message: In dec_open(), the newly introduced Decoder.subtitle_header field is assigned directly from ist->dec_ctx->subtitle_header (a pointer owned/managed by the decoder's AVCodecContext, i.e. by libavcodec). No copy of the underlying buffer is made; Decoder.subtitle_header is simply an alias to memory owned by the AVCodecContext. When the AVCodecContext is later closed/freed (avcodec_free_context, e.g. during decoder teardown or dec_free), the buffer that subtitle_header points to can be released or reallocated by libavcodec, while consumers of Decoder.subtitle_header (e.g. the subtitle encoder path which reads dec->subtitle_header/subtitle_header_size to initialize its own codec context) may still read from it afterward, resulting in a use-after-free / dangling pointer read. The field was also declared as `const uint8_t *`, further indicating the intent was only to reference, not own, the memory, with no corresponding free path.
findings.suggestion: Deep-copy the subtitle_header buffer into memory owned by the Decoder struct instead of storing a raw pointer into the AVCodecContext. Allocate a buffer of subtitle_header_size (+1 for NUL termination, since ASS code assumes a null-terminated buffer), memcpy the contents, and free it explicitly when the Decoder is destroyed (dec_free). Change the field type from `const uint8_t *` to a mutable, decoder-owned `uint8_t *` so ownership is clear.

ground_truth.root_cause: A pointer-only copy (shallow copy) of a buffer owned by another object's lifetime (AVCodecContext) is stored in a longer-lived structure (Decoder) without duplicating the buffer or establishing correct ownership/lifetime semantics, and no corresponding free/retain mechanism exists.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Decoder.subtitle_header stores a borrowed pointer into the AVCodecContext, leading to use-after-free
